UPSC IFS Mains Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the mains exam date for the post of Civil Services / Forest Service IAS / IFS. This recruitment has been issued for 1013 posts. The online application process for UPSC IFS Mains Online Form 2026 were accepted from 13 July 2026, to 22 July 2026. The Mains Examination is going to conducted from 22-29 September 2026. Candidates must Download their UPSC IFS Mains Exam Date 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2026
  • Last Date : 27 February 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 February 2027
  • Correction/ Edit Form : 28 February to 03 March 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 24 May 2026
  • Admit Card : 15 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 27 May 2026
  • Result : 15 June 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 17 June 2026
  • Mains Online Form IAS
  • Application Start Date : 19 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 June 2026
  • Mains Online Form IFS
  • Application Start Date : 13 July 2026
  • Last Date : 22 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 21, 22, 23, 29, 30 August 2026
  • IAS Mains Admit Card : 14 August 2026
  • IFS Mains Exam Date : 22-29 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, SC, Female, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
